comments.author: bashonly
comments.body:
Reverted in 017d76edcf05186df2073bdb5b8351a87f596f4c

It's likely that this workaround only works for certain clients. My guess would be the `web*` family of clients and `mweb`. It is harmful when used with `tv*` clients, incurring a 403 error during download that is sometimes delayed by 30-60 seconds not unlike PO token enforcement.

I'm open to adding this extractor-arg again in the future, but as an **opt-in only** feature, and *only* after thorough research has been conducted into which clients it is compatible with. Also, I would prefer a technical & unattractive arg name like `use_ad_playback_context` (which was my initial instinct, along with it being opt-in only, but I stupidly felt like taking a risk tonight)

One of `always` (always try fetch a PO Token regardless if the client requires one for the given context), `never` (never fetch a PO Token), or `auto` (default; only fetch a PO Token if the client requires one for the given context)

+* `request_no_ads`: Skip preroll ads to eliminate the mandatory wait period before download. Either `true` (the default if unauthenticated) or `false`. The default is `false` when logged-in cookies have been passed to yt-dlp, since `true` will result in a loss of premium formats
 
 #### youtube-ejs
 * `jitless`: Run suported Javascript engines in JIT-less mode. Supported runtimes are `deno`, `node` and `bun`. Provides better security at the cost of performance/speed. Do note that `node` and `bun` are still considered unsecure. Either `true` or `false` (default)
